questions.question:
In this question three statements are given followed by three conclusions I, II and III. You have to consider the three statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

All birds are kites.

Some kites are imported.

No imported thing is red.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No kite is red.

(II) Some birds are red.

(III) Some kites are red.

options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follow.

questions.solution:
__**Statements:**__

All birds are kites.

Some kites are imported.

No imported thing is red.

__**Venn diagram:**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88cbf5dfd7ef9a09ff2f55acd39674b3655124f168a78cbfd9a1856a2fc8629f.png] 

__**Conclusions:**__

(I) No kite is red→ Does not follow → From the given information we don't have the data that suggests the relationship between kite and red this conclusion may be true but without relevant data we cannot assume therefore the conclusion does not follow.

(II) Some birds are red→ Does not follow → Since 'all birds are kites' and 'some kites are imported' it can be also stated that some birds are imported and we are given that 'no imported thing can be red' so the conclusion does not follow.

(III) Some kites are red→ Does not follow → From the statements, there is no specific relation provided which can prove the connection between kites and red so it is not safe to conclude anything and thus the conclusion does not follow.

So, **none of the conclusions follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "option (4)".**

Some drawings are paintings.

**Conclusions:**

**Distance from point P to A = 14.3 - (10.7 + 3.2) ⇒ 14.3 - 13.9 = 0.4km**

Hence, the correct answer is **"option (3)".**
